summary: La-doped ZrO2 thin films were grown by O3-based atomic layer deposition directly on Ge(100). The films exhibited a dielectric constant of 29 after annealing at 400 °C. The study focused on the thermally induced permittivity enhancement and the role of Ge interdiffusion in stabilizing the tetragonal ZrO2 phase.
evidence: La-doped ZrO2 thin films grown by O3-based atomic layer deposition directly on Ge(100) exhibit a dielectric constant of 29. Upon annealing in N2 at 400 °C, a high value is extracted for film thickness below 15 nm. Ge interdiffusion from the substrate is correlated with the stabilization of the tetragonal ZrO2 phase.
